problem: The local model guessed unfamiliar terminology or asked for context, with no real web tool available in direct-question tests.
change: Shared DDGS search and public HTML/text reading in all four question harnesses, with source receipts, persisted operation limits, a shorter knowledge-investigation prompt and a question-only profile that hides unrelated virtual file tools. No semantic delivery gate or fixed response schema.

conditions.purpose: Test whether shared optional web tools let the unchanged local model investigate unfamiliar concepts instead of guessing or returning only a clarification request.
conditions.conditions: Same fixed local Qwen2.5 14B profile, empty supplied documents for concept questions. The shared task prompt and web capabilities change together; this is not an isolated orchestration ablation. Web responses are live and may differ between runs. One run per case/configuration; these are exposed development checks, not research accuracy estimates.

limitations: Exposed development questions, one run per configuration/case/revision, unblinded assistant review. No accuracy estimate or stable reliability claim.
The shared task prompt and tool availability change together against the earlier no-web implementation. Live results vary; this is not an isolated orchestration comparison.
Eight persisted web-tool attempts are not eight HTTP requests; redirects and fallback searches may make more requests.
Bing succeeded in the provider smoke check; DuckDuckGo returned no usable results. Provider availability is not guaranteed.
Public HTML/text only. No PDF parsing, authenticated pages or browser JavaScript rendering. Pages can be truncated at 10,000 characters.
OS DNS resolution is not hard-interrupt bounded; seven-second network deadlines are per hop, not a total run SLA.
Source retrieval and citations do not establish that every claim is supported. Web errors remain visible; the agent decides what to do next.
The progress projection still summarizes the original local-source jobs; web receipts and activity are visible separately, but no progress-feedback benefit is established.
No real ASR, live conversation, user study or speed benefit is tested. Historical baseline scores remain unchanged.
